title: Punnett squares
summary: Complete a Punnett square for a chosen pair of parents and read the offspring ratio off the cells.

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: A four-cell Punnett square with both parents named along the top and the side, and two boxes for the offspring genotypes and the ratio.
accessibility.textAlternative: A Punnett square with Aa along the top and Aa down the side, and A the dominant allele. The four cells hold 1 AA, 2 Aa, 1 aa, so the offspring ratio is 1:2:1.

parentA.label: First parent
parentA.description: The genotype along the top of the square.

parentB.label: Second parent
parentB.description: The genotype down the side of the square.

grading.rationaleTemplate: You listed {answer.offspring} and the ratio {answer.ratio}; the cells give {expected.offspring} and {expected.ratio}.
